title: Q-LESSON-unshallow-before-history: enforce the lesson in code
body:
**Owner:** executor
**Trigger:** lesson `unshallow-before-history` in doctrine/lessons.json has no enforcing code
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation lessons --check
**Status:** open

LESSONS-1: make session bootstrap unshallow the clone before any history claim, and fail a history-reading command on a shallow clone. Then add the binding to the lesson in doctrine/lessons.json and close this item.

**Prediction:** shallow_history_claims <= 0 within 168 h
**Out of scope:** CI checkouts, which already use fetch-depth 0.

size: M

**Closing probe:** `python3 -m foundation lessons --report` lists `unshallow-before-history` as enforced.
